sources.title: The profitability of technical trading rules in the Bitcoin market
Bitcoin Price Direction Forecasting and Market Variables

hypothesis: A slow Bitcoin trend filter captures positive long-run drift while avoiding prolonged bear regimes, improving risk-adjusted returns relative to continuous long exposure.
data: Binance USD-M perpetual 1h plus actual historical funding
signal: At each UTC day boundary, target long 1.0 only if the prior completed daily close is above the SMA computed only from closes available before the decision; otherwise cash.
execution: Position changes at current 00:00 UTC open; no same-day close execution.
funding: Actual funding cash flows while long are included.
development_gate: canonical net Sharpe >0.70, positive total return, at least 2/3 SMA windows positive
success_gate: canonical exploratory OOS net Sharpe >1, positive return at 2x cost, at least 2/3 neighbors positive, 2024 and 2025 each non-negative
